subject: Final-stage capacity request: dedicated GPU hold and sizing for Nova AI launch
messages:
From: Sonia Patel <sonia@novaai.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Dedicated capacity request — launch window June (NOVA-228)

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We're in final-stage planning for a limited beta launch in early June and need to lock down dedicated capacity before our procurement window closes next week. High-level asks: 

- Target start: week of 2026-06-01
- Desired capacity: 8x A100 (40GB) reserved for production inference, with burst to additional GPUs during peak batch jobs
- Expected steady-state: ~18 qps with 32-token avg responses (~20k tokens/day)
- Duration: initial 3 months, then evaluate consumption for a committed reserved contract

Can Redwood place a temporary hold on the capacity while we finish procurement? We can share the mutual action plan (attached) and our initial traffic profile. If you need a more detailed sizing profile, tell us which template to fill and we'll return it today.

Attachments: nva_launch_request.pdf (overview + timeline)

Sonia Patel
Head of Product Operations
Nova AI
sonia@novaai.com
+1 415-555-0198

Date: 2026-05-15T10:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity request — launch window June (NOVA-228)

Hi Sonia — great to hear you're close. We can provisionally hold capacity for limited windows, but we need the traffic profile to size properly (concurrency, rps spikes, max tokens, and expected batch jobs).

Quick answers to your ask:
- We can place a soft hold for up to 14 days while procurement completes.
- For a firm 3-month reserve we'll need a signed SOW or PO and the sizing template returned.

I've attached our GPU sizing template (gpu_sizing_template.xlsx). Please fill the fields marked "required": average RPS, 95th percentile concurrent requests, avg/max sequence length, and any batch training/batch encode jobs. Once we have that Marissa and Karthik will run an inventory check against us-west-2 capacity and confirm whether we can commit the 8x A100s or recommend a nearby configuration.

If it helps, we can also provision a short-term dedicated pool backed by our Dedicated offering with a temporary credit hold while procurement finalizes. Let me know the internal deadline so I can set the soft hold.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
dylan_brooks@redwood.com

Attachment: gpu_sizing_template.xlsx

Hi Sonia — quick update and confirmation.

Per the internal capacity check, we can place a soft hold for 8x A100 (40GB) in us-west-2 for the period 2026-05-24 through 2026-08-24 under deal NOVA-228. This is a provisional hold (soft hold) while procurement completes — we ask for a signed SOW/PO within 14 days of the start date to convert to a firm reservation. If procurement needs longer, we can discuss a short extension but that would be evaluated against other commitments.

Notes from infra: inventory snapshot attached (gpu_inventory_snapshot_us-west-2.csv). They also suggested a fallback of 6x A100 + 2x 80GB for cost/throughput efficiency if your final profile shows higher batch jobs; we'll run sizing against the completed template and send a recommended configuration.

Next steps: 
- Sonia / Nova: return filled gpu_sizing_template.xlsx by EOD 2026-05-21
- Redwood: if sizing matches preliminary profile, we will convert soft hold to firm upon receipt of signed SOW/PO (14-day window)
- I'll add the MAP link here: https://docs.redwood.com/ma-plans/NOVA-228-MAP and share a DocuSign for the SOW once we have the completed template.
